stories.title: Blizzard stops most travel in Northeast
stories.summary: Blizzard conditions kept people at home from Delaware to coastal New England, with many communities seeing record snowfall. Travel was banned and clean up will be a big project in many towns.

stories.title: With horse whinnies, there's more than meets the ear
stories.summary: A horse's whinny is an unusually distinctive mix of sounds including both high and low frequencies, a new study in Current Biology shows.

stories.title: Mexico's military regains control after violence over the killing of a cartel leader
stories.summary: Mexico braced for more violence following an eruption of clashes after the armed killed the leader of a powerful cartel

stories.title: Urban sketchers turn cityscapes into art
stories.summary: In cities around the world, groups of people get together to do on-location drawing in the place where they live. They say it helps them notice new things in their city.

stories.title: Trump says he ended the war in DR Congo, but the fighting is far from over
stories.summary: In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as government troops and militia allies battle Rwanda-backed M23 rebels for control of mineral-rich land, civilians pay the price in a brutal war.

stories.title: Volunteers help make up the difference after national parks service cuts
stories.summary: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the busiest National park in the U.S., but with the park service cutting nearly a quarter of all positions last year, volunteers have made up the difference.
